text: I think the idea is quite great and has a lot of potential, but having to pay to read the full stories takes away quite a lot from that. For an app that it's meant to help people, i wouldn't say remove all forms of monetization, but maybe trying a more ad oriented experience or doing exclusive/free stories could work a lot better and allow people to benefit from the app without having to pay for it.
